assignments.brief: Assess the prevailing macro regime for the subject: growth, inflation, policy path and the rates and currency implications. State what would change your view.

Reconcile the contributions into a single thesis revision. State the position, the invalidation criteria, and which implementation implications the thesis carries. Record any perspective that was unavailable.
Test the macro view against the data: regime indicators, historical analogues, and whether the claimed relationships hold statistically.
Argue the opposite case as strongly as the evidence permits. Identify the assumption the thesis cannot survive being wrong about.
Assess the exposure acting on this thesis would create: sizing, concentration, liquidity and tail risk.
Check every factual claim the thesis rests on against its cited evidence. Record discrepancies rather than correcting them.
